title: What Do You Think Keeps Your Flask Coffee Hot?
summary: A thermos has two walls with almost no air between them, so heat has very little to travel through. The same trick also keeps cold drinks cold.

beats.text: How does a flask keep your coffee hot for hours? Is it thick foam, a vacuum, or a heater? Pause and guess!

visual.text: How does a flask stay hot?

beats.text: Heat always escapes from hot things to cold things. It moves through touching materials, and through air.
Time's up. What is between the walls?
beats.reveal: A vacuum! Two walls with almost no air between them, so heat has little to travel through.

visual.question: What sits between the two walls?

beats.text: Three tricks work together, and the last one is the lid.
Bonus fact: the same trick keeps cold drinks cold, because it slows heat coming in.

visual.text: A flask does not make heat or cold. It just slows heat moving in or out.
